physicalNotes: Radius 3.2 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract): 2,226,240 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.57 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6164 +/- 202 K from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
